messages.subject: Wallace temporarily off CRAN
parts:
It's possible Wallace may go off CRAN in the next few days.
If you find install.packages("wallace") does not work,  you can try to install Wallace via GitHub with the following line of code, but things should be fixed in the next few days:

devtools::install_github("https://github.com/wallaceEcoMod/wallace")
